models.name: Flux.1 Schnell (GGUF)
models.description: Black Forest Labs FLUX.1 [schnell] 4-step distilled diffusion model via stable-diffusion.cpp. Uses 4-bit quantized diffusion weights and quantized T5-XXL text encoder, fitting in 8-12 GB VRAM.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 4B (Nunchaku SVDQ)
models.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B quantized with SVDQuant (4-bit weights and activations) running on Nunchaku engine. Supports both INT4 (r32) and FP4 (r32) for ultra-fast inference on RTX 30/40/50 GPUs.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 4B (OrbitQuant W4A4)
models.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B compressed with OrbitQuant W4A4 (Weight 4-bit, Activation 4-bit) with quantized rotation transforms by WaveCut. High quality 4-step generation with minimal memory footprint.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 4B
models.description: Compact 4B-parameter Flux.2 Klein — the smallest Klein variant (~2.1 GB transformer). Lighting backend, 4 steps. Key-protected: requires the bundled free-trial test key (config.json) or a personal QuantFunc API key.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 9B KV (Nunchaku SVDQ)
models.description: FLUX.2 Klein 9B with KV caching quantized with SVDQuant for Nunchaku engine. Fast 4-step generation with INT4-r32 or Blackwell FP4-r32.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 9B (Nunchaku SVDQ)
models.description: FLUX.2 Klein 9B quantized with SVDQuant for Nunchaku engine. Fast generation with INT4-r32 or Blackwell FP4-r32.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 9B (OrbitQuant W4A4)
models.description: FLUX.2 Klein 9B flagship model compressed with OrbitQuant W4A4 by WaveCut. High fidelity 4-step generation requiring substantially less VRAM than FP16 or BF16.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 9B
models.description: Flagship 9B-parameter Flux.2 Klein for high-quality text-to-image. Lighting backend only (no SVDQ for 9B). Optimized for RTX 50-series+ via FP4 native path. Key-protected: requires the bundled free-trial test key (config.json) or a personal QuantFunc API key.

models.name: Flux.2 Klein 9B Base (GGUF)
models.description: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 [klein] 9B Base (undistilled foundation model) via stable-diffusion.cpp with Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 GGUF quantizations. Powered by Qwen3-8B Q8/Q4 text encoder and Flux2 VAE.

models.name: Flux.3 Image Klein (Nunchaku SVDQ)
models.description: FLUX.3 Image Klein model quantized with SVDQuant for Nunchaku (vitoom) engine. Uses shared Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder.

models.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein (GGUF)
models.description: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image Klein (16-step distilled) via stable-diffusion.cpp with GGUF quantizations from Abiray. Multimodal diffusion model with Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K_M, Q4_K_M, and Q3_K_S variants, powered by Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder and Flux2 VAE.

models.name: Ideogram 4 (Quantized)
models.description: Text & typography specialist model by QuantFunc (Pending ModelScope Release). Designed for accurate text rendering, signboards, logos, poster designs, and stylized labels.

models.name: MOSS-Image SFT (GGUF)
models.description: MOSS-Image-SFT via stable-diffusion.cpp. Powered by Qwen3.5-9B UD-Q4_K_XL encoder and Flux2 VAE.

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 (Nunchaku SVDQ)
models.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 quantized with SVDQuant for Nunchaku (vitoom) engine. Uses shared Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder.

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 Turbo (Nunchaku SVDQ)
models.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 Turbo distilled model quantized with SVDQuant for Nunchaku (vitoom) engine. Fast 8-step generation with shared Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder.

models.name: Qwen-Image 13B (Quantized)
models.description: Flagship 13B-parameter Qwen-Image model by QuantFunc. Exceptional prompt comprehension, photorealism, and complex multi-subject composition. Pre-quantized for RTX 30/40/50 series.

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 (4-bit INT4) [Не реком. / Raw]
models.description: ⚠️ Не рекомендуется (сырое квантование с артефактами — используйте версию SDNQ Turbo INT8 или Unsloth GGUF). Pre-quantized Qwen-Image-2.1 INT4 model by QuantFunc.

models.name: Qwen-Image-Edit (Quantized)
models.description: Multimodal image editing & inpainting model by QuantFunc. Specialized for image-to-image transformations, style transfer, object addition/removal, and prompt-driven line-art / photo edits. Optimized for RTX 30/40/50 series GPUs.

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 (Unsloth GGUF)
models.description: Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.1 running via stable-diffusion.cpp with Unsloth GGUF quantizations. Features modular Q4_K_M / Q4_K_S DiT, Qwen3-VL-8B multimodal LLM encoder, and Wan VAE.

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 Turbo (SDNQ INT8)
models.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 Turbo (8-step distilled) quantized with SDNQ Dynamic INT8 + Hadamard Rotation (group_size 256) by OzzyGT. Includes INT8 Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder and INT8 DiT transformer. Runs on 12–16 GB VRAM GPUs (RTX 5060 Ti / 4070 / 3090) with CPU offload and Texture-Fix VAE.

models.name: SDXL Turbo (GGUF)
models.description: Ultra-fast single-step SDXL Turbo via stable-diffusion.cpp (Q4_0 GGUF). Produces high quality 512x512 images in 1-4 steps with very low VRAM requirements (fits in 6-8 GB).

models.name: Z-Image Turbo (OrbitQuant W4A4)
models.description: Z-Image-Turbo compressed with OrbitQuant W4A4 with quantized rotation transforms by WaveCut. High speed generation (~3.1 GB weights).

models.name: Z-Image Turbo
models.description: Ultra-fast distilled text-to-image model (Alibaba Tongyi Z-Image-Turbo), pre-quantized for the QuantFunc Lighting engine. ~1.2s per image on RTX 4090. Lightest series (~6.5 GB total) — best choice for a first end-to-end test. Runs on RTX 20-series and above.
